name: Explain specific legal concepts and procedures
description: Users asked for explanations, definitions, or detailed breakdowns of specific legal concepts, statutory provisions, and procedural mechanisms across various jurisdictions and legal systems. The requests covered a wide range of topics, including civil, criminal, constitutional, and international law, with some users seeking simplification or comparative analysis of these legal principles.
